company_name: Fukuoka Industry, Science and Technology Foundation,Fukuoka Solution Center for Adv
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company is focused on advancing semiconductor packaging technologies, particularly in 3D semiconductors.
summary: Fukuoka Industry, Science and Technology Foundation, through its Fukuoka Solution Center for Advanced Semiconductor Packaging, plays a significant role in the semiconductor value chain by advancing packaging technologies. The center supports innovation in ultra-integrated semiconductor solutions and collaborates with private companies to enhance the local semiconductor ecosystem.

regional_presence.Japan: The center engages in initiatives that promote regional revitalization through collaborations with private companies, enhancing the local semiconductor ecosystem.
